Based on the visual analysis of the time series plot, there is a distinct shift in the level of the data (a step change) occurring around index 510. The values jump from fluctuating between roughly -10 and +10 to fluctuating between roughly +10 and +25. This entire subsequent period represents an anomaly relative to the baseline established in the first 500 points.

The anomalous range starts at approximately x = 510 and continues to the end of the plotted data at x = 730.

[[510, 730]]
